source_scope: Targeted comparisons only; not full Rhetorius extraction

comparisons.topic: Attendance is not one cross-author predicate

ptolemy.summary: Luminary attendance supports status gradations; the note reports a specific Porphyry/Hephaestion luminary mode.

rhetorius.summary: Begins with angular dignified planet attended by another dignified planet, then gives luminary and sect alternatives; distinguishes out-of-sect attendance and gives trine/square attendance greater force than sextile.

comparisons.disposition: Keep each definition with author and scope. The note explicitly says definitions vary; no generic doryphory score can replace these without a declared choice.

ptolemy.summary: Two admission routes: nearest morning appearance and culmination/lunar relation; reconcile both, then conditional fallback.

rhetorius.summary: Includes several effective houses, sixth house, Fortune, lunar application and morning/evening appearance seven days before or after; also reports Anubio lunar-syzygy and dispositor approaches.

comparisons.disposition: Seven-day window and additional admission routes remain Rhetorius-specific here, not retroactively supplied to Ptolemy. Full Rhetorius compilation is pending.

ptolemy.summary: Sign-form modifiers and Moon–Mercury four-group special-role list.

rhetorius.summary: Introduces the corresponding material as Ptolemy teaching; closely repeats groups. Holden notes solstitial/equinoctial and measuring/agriculture differences, plus pickling/fishing and other translation distinctions.

comparisons.disposition: Track explicit literary dependence. Repetition is not independent observational corroboration, and variants are retained rather than averaged away.

comparisons.topic: Overcoming versus aspect and obscure closing phrase

ptolemy.summary: Uses benefic/malefic overcoming for amplitude/outcomes and leaves cold/colour-mixture phrase with commentator explanation.

rhetorius.summary: Corresponding English text uses aspected; closing Saturn phrase differs and Holden calls it corrupt.

comparisons.disposition: This is a verified translation/witness-level difference, not independently established Greek doctrinal disagreement. Neither arbitrary aspect substitution nor invented repair of the closing phrase is admitted.
